'''Asair's Ribbon''' was an uncharted quadrant of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. It was frequented by the renegade [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Trai Novi]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
